description: Figure 7 displays the distribution of articles across several media outlets. The chart consists of 13 slices, each representing a different news source. The slices are labeled as follows: The Huffington Post (blue, approximately 14%), NPR (light blue, approximately 8%), Vox (teal, approximately 7%), Breitbart (red, approximately 6%), The Guardian (green, approximately 5%), BBC (purple, approximately 5%), RT (orange, approximately 4%), Daily Kos/Raw Story (yellow, approximately 3%), Daily Caller/Breitbart (brown, approximately 3%), Fox News (pink, approximately 3%), and “Other” (gray, approximately 13%). Additionally, there are three unlabeled slices with values of 2, 1, and 1. The chart includes a legend identifying each color with its corresponding media outlet. The slices appear to be ordered from largest to smallest proportion, moving clockwise around the circle. Percentage values are not displayed directly on the slices, but numerical values are provided alongside each label.
